# Cozy pass evidence

Offscreen renders (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, isolated XDG tree, software GL), not host or VM captures.
`before-*` come from HorneroOS/shell main at e9c66af, `after-*` from this branch. Surfaces are real Content
components in a panel-coloured frame, so layer placement matches the shell; window services are shimmed.
The full 49-image set (night, day, High Contrast) lives in the mission evidence folder `evidence/cozy-pass`.
